description: This file contains unit tests for data element classes in the WPEFramework Core namespace, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests functionality such as copying, sizing, validation, searching, setting, and linked data elements.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: A class representing a generic data element capable of various data manipulations such as copying, searching, and setting values within its buffer.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: A class managing a buffer for data storage, supporting size manipulation and buffer access.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: A parser class for processing DataElement objects, allowing operations like skipping bytes and validation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A class representing linked data elements, supporting linked structures and buffer management.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore or DataElement buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataStore or DataElement buffer.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC checksum over the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement is valid.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a numeric value within the DataElement buffer, considering endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a numeric value within the DataElement buffer, considering endianness.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence of bytes within the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets a specific bit range within the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specified offset within the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement buffer to a certain boundary.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Establishes linkages between linked data elements.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer for a specified range within the DataElement or LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of linked data elements.
